listing.name: Kazeron Navarchy
listing.aiSummary: Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in.

description:
Originally created by PeachPatrol, Kazeron Navarchy has been revived for 0.98a.

Massive thanks to Reeeves, RoaringWriter and Lilium|Stargazzer| for their support!

Download Kazeron Navarchy!

"Adds several skins to the Persean League, each with the Kazeron Navarchy hullmod built in. They appear occasionally in Persean League markets and fleets.

I've always thought that the Persean League didn't have enough to make it interesting, so I made some colorful skins for them.

Shouldn't have any requirements."

Changes from the original mod:

SpoilerChange log - - 1.8.0v - - 07. 06. 2026

[Ships]

Added skins from BigBeans Ship Compilation:

- Accipiter

- Buzzard

Minor adjustments:

- Drover

- Pegasus

[Hullmod]

- Updated Navarchy hullmod to have 15% speed increase, shield bonus 5%, with a drawback of -75 armor.

Change log - - 1.7.1v - - 21. 10. 2025

[Ships]

Added 1 new skin:

- Gemini PL

Change log - - 1.7.0v - - 27. 05. 2025

[Weapons]

- All ballistic weapon slots of Kazeron Navarchy vessels switched with hybrid slots

- Replaced all existing weapon loadouts accordingly

[Ships]

Removed following vessels:

- Odyssey

- Valkyrie

- Switched built-in weapons on the Monitor with Heavy Burst Laser

- Full paintjob rework on all remaining ships

- Navarchy vessel raraity lowered from 0.5 to 0.4

[close]

Preview:

Spoiler

[close]

Plans... well, add more ships.
